description.value:
You are bonded to one of the twelve Gold Cloths. It is medium armor (+4 AC, Dex cap +1, check penalty −2, Strength 16), free at 1st level, and it accepts armor runes normally.

You can summon or dismiss it with a single Interact action. It cannot be removed from you by any means short of destroying it. If you are reduced to 0 Hit Points the Cloth cracks; it self-repairs after 24 hours, or instantly in the hands of a Saint of Aries.

Your Cloth determines your four Techniques, your Cloth Passive, both of your boons, and the one constellation whose rising you can feel.
